disposition: Candidate 1 retained; candidate 2 adds fixed selected-port tagged/returned trials, a separate sibling-phase sign control and nine-read comparison scopes. Candidate 2 approved unchanged. Independent scientific referee pending.

root_at_freeze.handling: Require a fixed-mask comparison at h=0000 with an orthogonal copy of every spent word present, ignored, and coherently returned. Check complete go/decline matrices and original-launch rates including 15/16 refused for the fully tagged erasure. Separate a tag on the changed sibling, and a physical sign swap with a fixed or correspondingly relabelled mask.
root_at_freeze.strongest_objection: Pooling all erasure outputs hides a residual copy of the paid word. The pooled test gives the same answer for both a clean eraser and a fully tagged past.

root_at_freeze.handling: On a fixed mask the revised design requires the tagged D numerator for each individual h and 15/16 refusal, then requires the clean Q numerator at each h after coherent return. A sibling value tag and an actual input phase reversal have distinct matched controls.
